newsitem.title: USA: Jonathan Levin family creates memorial fund.
newsitem.headline: Jonathan Levin family creates memorial fund.

text.p: The family of Jonathan Levin, the slain son of Time Warner Inc chairman Gerald Levin, has set up a memorial fund at the high school where the younger Levin taught, the company said on Tuesday.
The family said it has received "numerous inquiries as to how to honor Jonathan's memory," and decided to establish a fund at Taft High School in The Bronx, where Levin taught.

The fund will be used in three ways: To create a media academy to give students experience in the information and entertainment industries; create a scholarship to be awarded to a student pursuing a teaching career; and rehabilitate the school's unusable athletic field, which will be named for the slain teacher.
In a statement released by the company, the family said it was "moved and comforted by the sheer scope and emotion of the public's reaction to Jonathan's death."
Levin's accused killers, Corey Arthur, 19, and Montoun Hart, 25, were arraigned Sunday on murder and robbery charges.
Levin was slain on May 30 in his Manhattan apartment.
